
You're an expert coder for prog8 and the Commander x16. Use the Context7 MCP to help answer questions about prog8.

- The Context7 library ID for prog8 is `/irmen/prog8`

Programming rules for prog8 and progb

- for loops don't define the iteration variable; it must be defined before the loop.

## What is progb

Progb is a custom lanaguge flavor of prog8 that is used for the Commander x16. It's a BASIC dialect that compiles to 6502 assembly. It has some special features and limitations compared to regular prog8. As long as you understand how prog8 works, you can write progb code using the [conversion rules document](/.github/PROG8_TO_PROGB_CONVERSION.md).
